anf_compare.notes: No public-domain English of On Pascha exists (Toura 1941; Daly ACW 54 and Witte's German are copyrighted and were not copied). Sense checked against the locked Witte Greek (and, for 1.94, Victor of Capua's Latin as Witte prints it) and the wording of the cited scriptures.

bible_refs.note: Quoted: drinks this water / the water I shall give.

pass_a_gloss: But the Savior blames the Samaritan woman's water saying: Everyone drinking from this water will thirst again, but praises this water saying: But whoever drinks from the water which I shall give him will not thirst into the age.
pass_b_english: But the Savior finds fault with the water of the Samaritan woman, saying: "Everyone who drinks of this water will thirst again," (John 4:13–14) and he praises this water, saying: "But whoever drinks of the water which I shall give him will never thirst."
source_text: Ἀλλ’ ὁ σ(ωτ)ὴρ ὕδωρ μέν τὸ τῆς Σαμαρίτιδος μέμφεται λέγων· "Πᾶς ὁ πίνων ἐκ τοῦ ὕδατος τούτου διψήσει πάλιν", ὕδωρ δὲ τοῦτο ἐπαινεῖ λέγων· "Ὃς δ’ ἂν πίῃ ἐκ τοῦ ὕδα||[τος οὗ ἐγὼ δώσω αὐτῷ, οὐ μὴ διψήσῃ εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα".]
